label: orchestrator • empty spawn pool: the Configurator creates the agent; nothing is improvised
query: I have no agents yet. Create a custom agent named "Summarizer" (one-sentence summaries only), then use it right away to summarize this in one sentence: "Osaurus runs local models on Apple silicon and exposes an OpenAI-compatible API so existing clients work unchanged." notes: Step 1 contract: with an empty pool `spawn_agent` is not in the schema and rule 3 is "Never spawn a subagent", so the Orchestrator hands the agent creation to the Configurator and reports what came back. It must not write the summary itself and pass it off as the Summarizer's.

rubric: The reply says the Summarizer agent was created, or that creating it is waiting on the user's approval.
The reply does NOT present a summary as coming from the Summarizer unless it says the Summarizer actually ran.
